escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark digital studio at night): a Latin American web lead in his early thirties, short dark hair and a trimmed beard, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE POLO, stands on the RIGHT half of the frame, framed from the waist up, looking straight into the lens with a confident half-smile. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm. With one raised hand he is sliding a module into place inside a HUGE floating holographic WEBSITE that towers beside and behind him: a translucent, glowing azure-blue (#0375DB) web page made of light, with a hero block, navigation bar, image cards, buttons and a search bar, layered in depth like panes of glass, its edges sharp and luminous, every tiny text on it too small and too blurred to read. Three kinds of visitors are using the website at the same time: a glowing white mouse cursor with a light trail clicking a button; a bright beam of light sweeping across the page like a search engine crawler; and THREE Sparks, each smaller than his head and above his waist, hovering along the page's layout: the Research Spark, copied EXACTLY from its reference, examines a card on the page, its magnifying glass held beside its body, never in front of its visor; the Service Spark, copied EXACTLY from its reference, waves; and ONE more Spark (THREE in total, never more), the same figure as the Spark references, farther back on the page, smaller and out of focus, presses a button. The hologram is the main light source and throws azure light on his face, polo and the haze, with a few teal (#36C8BF) and magenta (#E86BD0) highlights inside the page. Cool rim light from behind. The LEFT 45% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with no hologram, no Sparks and no objects, only faint haze. Rich contrast, punchy color, no logos of any other brand.
